verdicts.reason: A is just the original stack shrunk into the strip. The headline is tiny (about 9px) and the CTA sits squeezed underneath it, both pushed right of centre, leaving the left third as dead orange and the vertical stack cramped against the top and bottom edges. B correctly reflows to a left-to-right banner, with a headline big enough to read and the CTA on the right. But the two-line headline nearly touches the top and bottom edges, the left margin is much wider than the right, and the CTA pill is small and close to the edge, so the layout needs polish.
